summary.zh-Hans: 开元寺的东、西两侧分别立着镇国塔和仁寿塔，现存的两座石塔建于宋代。
summary.en: The stone pagodas on the east and west sides of Kaiyuan Temple are Zhenguo and Renshou. Both surviving towers date to the Song dynasty.

summary.zh-Hans: 洛阳桥是宋代修建的跨海石桥，位于洛阳江入海口。桥墩朝向上游的一侧设有船形分水尖，用来缓解水流的冲击。
summary.en: Built in the Song dynasty, Luoyang Bridge spans the estuary of the Luoyang River. Boat-shaped points on the upstream sides of its piers help ease the force of the current.

summary.zh-Hans: 泉州面线糊用细面线和高汤煮制，加入食用淀粉勾芡。食用时可搭配卤蛋、醋肉等熟食配料。
summary.en: Quanzhou mee sua soup combines fine noodles and stock, thickened with starch. Cooked toppings can include braised eggs and cu rou pork.

summary.zh-Hans: 润饼菜用薄面饼皮包卷熟制的蔬菜、肉类等馅料。花生末、海苔等可作为辅料，馅料可按口味选择。
summary.en: Runbing wraps cooked vegetables, meat and other fillings in a thin flour wrapper. Crushed peanuts and seaweed are among the optional additions.
